download_vocab_alpha1e0: download the vocab_alpha1e0 vocabulary model to the specified datapath using the build function
build_vocab_alpha1e0: build the vocab_alpha1e0 vocabulary model archive by calling the build function with version v1.0
summarize_download: summarize the download function which fetches the 90M parameter Blender model vocabulary
